subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: Should `warning?: string` become the permanent exported config-write and mutation result contract for comment-loss diagnostics?
rationale: The user-facing warning fixes established destructive behavior, but exposing the diagnostic through exported result types creates a lasting Plugin SDK contract whose shape and semantics require owner intent.

options.title: Approve the additive warning field
options.body: Keep the optional string result field, document that it reports comment-loss diagnostics, and require current-head normal and quiet/JSON CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the warning internal
options.body: Remove the exported result fields and retain only the pre-write logger or console warning, preserving the existing public result contract.

options.title: Design generic diagnostics first
options.body: Pause this PR until config writes have a typed multi-diagnostic result that can represent codes and affected paths without a one-off warning field.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive warning field
recommendation.body: Keep the optional string result field, document that it reports comment-loss diagnostics, and require current-head normal and quiet/JSON CLI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor most directly to config-write warning behavior in `src/config/io.ts`.
